sourcesNote: Names, descriptions and grades match the official list as published on Exophase (checked 2026-11-21). Hidden flags match GTABase and PlanetGTA6 (28 hidden, 27 visible). Guides are written in our own words from PowerPyx and GTABase; where a step is still unconfirmed, the guide says so.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: one playthrough, about 200 hours, no online trophies and no DLC needed.
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are done. There is nothing extra to do: no online trophy, no DLC, no difficulty setting. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger strands — and this pops last, after roughly 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, cannot be missed — it pops after the first main mission.
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. Just play through the opening and it pops automatically.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: pops once the first mission of Chapter 2 is underway.
trophies.guide: Finishing Chapter 1 earns this. It actually pops once the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, is underway. Keep playing the story and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.guide: Chapter 2's completion trophy. It pops as Chapter 3 opens, after the Welcome to Vice City mission. Automatic, story-only, impossible to miss.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Chapter 3's completion trophy. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Automatic — just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.guide: Chapter 4's completion trophy. It pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero. Automatic, story-only.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.quote: GTABase: finish the last mission of the story; free roam carries on afterwards.
trophies.guide: The gold story trophy for finishing the final mission. Play the last mission through and it unlocks with the credits; free-roam continues afterwards, so every other trophy can be cleaned up in the same playthrough.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, unlocks during the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the mission itself, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, unlocks during The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It unlocks during the mission; just play the story through.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, unlocks during Child's Play in Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play in Chapter 4. Automatic during the mission — no extra step needed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, unlocks during Headliners in Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners in Chapter 4. Automatic during the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, unlocks during the VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Automatic during the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, unlocks during Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory, the Chapter 5 mission. Automatic during the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: the checklist is closer to 60% true completion — most of it is partial counts.
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: the 100% Completion checklist, found under Progress > Stats after the story (progress made earlier still counts). It is closer to 60% true completion: full marks are needed only for robberies, underwater finds, shooting-range golds, drone races and Bret's Target Decks, plus partial counts — 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges and 300 stunts. Nothing on it is missable; everything stays open in free-roam.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: any 250 of 397 stunts; under-the-bridge flights are the quickest.
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four types however you like: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track them by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and note the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: the tracker counts 9 activity types; most arrive on their own.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball (sink a hoop), playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which types you still owe. Most arrive naturally while chasing other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.quote: GTABase: 42 golds across 12 ranges; ranges also raise your Focus level.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger. The golds are forgiving — work through one range at a time and this falls into place.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations, 42 drone races in total.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough for the trophy. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finishing every race at a location while you are there saves a return trip.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.quote: GTABase: win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; there are 40 unique race locations to choose from. Repeating a race you already won does not count, so pick 20 fresh ones and work through the map markers one by one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: after Feng Shui, Cal texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento (purple map icon). Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge to take the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 4 arcade games — 3 on the TV at home, 1 in cabinets around Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games all the way through: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, while Bang For Your Buck sits in arcade cabinets around Leonida. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: Andy's line is Lucia-only; 5 quests, starting with a call in Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her an address in Belville. Complete her five quests in order — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops on the last one. The quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 7 shipwrecks in total; Kenton texts Jason again in Chapter 2–3.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline opens in Chapter 1, a while after the Island Dreams mission; he calls, then shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — follow the purple chest markers, use the metal detector on the ocean floor, and bring each find back. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 but texts Jason again in Chapter 2–3, so nothing is missable; track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: Billy's 5 jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Do his five jobs in order — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops on the last. All stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count — Moses, Tyrone and Andy do NOT.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger mission strands around Leonida. Confirmed to count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Note that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. Watch the counter in your trophy list; more qualifying strands are still being confirmed, and all remain available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: Randy wants 16 sports cars; the list is under Map > Robberies.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you first use the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon); scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against his list, and look around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotels. Cars in good condition pay more. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: Jason-only; destroy the labs, then Tyrone gives the final job.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and opens after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3. Purple markers show the Synthetic Labs around Vice City — destroy enough of them in the Take Out Kitty Litter jobs and Tyrone hands you the final job, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), which awards the trophy. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 18 spots; meditating with both characters counts twice. The Chapter 1 one is the only possibly missable trophy in the game.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and you can only do the last one once both characters are playable together (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2). Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. MISSABLE WARNING: one meditation exists only in Chapter 1, at Jason's house — the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway, because it is gone after Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: which animal triggers it is still unconfirmed; all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when Bret texts Jason about Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple map icons) and bring them back as Jason; his unique rifle, the Killtelligence SM-69, comes from the first quest. Which exact animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed, but the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks, so finishing the line covers it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.quote: GTABase: any 3 sets; there are 18 sets in total.
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets — there are 18 sets in total. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is. You do not need to finish all 18.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher tags.
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app (hold Up, then R1). Any 100 count, drawn from 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. The 100% checklist wants 100 WAiNK scans too, so this lands on the way.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 80 challenges exist, only 50 needed here — 70 for the 100% checklist.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress > Challenges ticks the finished ones. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops automatically while working toward that — save the hardest challenges for last, since 10 can be skipped entirely.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: only counts once you are out of the red heat zone; the Ambrosia train tunnel works well.
trophies.guide: Available once Jason and Lucia can free-roam together (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2). Call your partner (hold Right, then Triangle), build a 4-star wanted level, then escape until you are clear of the red heat zone — not just the flashing search area. A good escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so this often pops on its own during Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: the pop is delayed ~30 seconds after the third shop; hit a 4th if it does not fire.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted (the flashing red/blue level, not the red heat level). Gear up first: armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City — open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — sit close together and work well. The pop is delayed by about 30 seconds after the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 557 vehicles at launch; scanning is enough, no need to drive them.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 while looking at a vehicle). You do not need to drive them — stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic. There are 557 vehicles at launch; the 100% checklist needs 200 base-model scans, so this comes free. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — use gang-operation thugs.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming), which slows time and highlights weak spots. Fill the purple focus bar first — eat, drink or wash up at home, and use Adrenaline to stretch the slow-mo — then line up 5 enemies at a gang operation with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to count on soldiers, police or civilians, and Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: the easiest jet is docked at gates E3/E4; fly about 1 km away.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge at VCIA — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The easiest is at gates E3/E4: drive through an airfield fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge, get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: tanks stand at the south end of Mile Zero Air Station.
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; the tanks sit at the south end of the base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: use the Snap Gun on the back door — kicking it in trips the alarm.
trophies.guide: First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, which unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies. Break into a store through its locked back door with the Snap Gun — kicking it in trips the alarm — then find the safe code note in the back room, empty the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, all without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good pick; the trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: each vault pays up to $205,000; Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to its bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner — the cash is too heavy for one person, so hand off a bag (hold Right). Each vault gives an instant 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and swap vehicles. There are 8 vaults total and the 100% checklist needs all 8; Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: robbing a bank vault counts; or sticky-bomb a truck driving near a bank.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that opens bank vaults counts: tailing the truck to the bank and robbing its vault qualifies. Earlier, you can box in an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back doors and blow them open — then escape the red heat radius or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: clear the fog from the whole map — fastest by plane.
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible. No specific order — just cover the entire state.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 9 gangs, 39 operations; track each gang under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations exist in total, marked by yellow icons when you get near them. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: Ocean View Rooftop Bar, order an Apple Martini. GTABase still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed.
trophies.guide: Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini; drink it standing by the bar with the view, and the trophy pops. Note: GTABase still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed, while PowerPyx names the bar and the drink — treat the PowerPyx route as the best current lead.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: only the blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. The pop is slightly delayed, firing after you drive away down the street; only the blue Banshee counts.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 3 valuables — watch, Gutterball shotgun, safe (code 0300).
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling — of its 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway (code 0300, or blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all three in one visit; the robbery icon takes a long time to respawn, so grab what you can each trip.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: max Strength with both characters at the same time; training one trains the other.
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength, heart icon). Buy a gym membership and always train together — call your partner (hold Right, then Triangle) — because while one character works out, the other trains too. Gyms are under Map > Activities; after the story you can also work out at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 500 profile actions; the Irredeemable profile is permanent — avoid it.
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the running total is visible by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications) to see a small demon face each time an action registers. Most players reach 500 passively through robberies and fights. Avoid the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent, and cops will shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: same store as the Prologue, as Lucia alone, and escape on foot — not in a vehicle.
trophies.guide: During the Prologue, Lucia robs a Payday Loans store. Come back later and rob the same store again as Lucia, alone — no Jason — then escape on foot, not in a vehicle. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. The store is the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City. Aim at the teller, deal with security, empty the 3 cash drawers, then run until you are clear of the search area; the pop is delayed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: UFO easter egg — after 2 AM, north-west of Starlet Motel, solo. The blinking car spawn is random.
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg: at night after 2 AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — the spawn is random, so drive away and return if it is not there. Follow the path into the woods from the car, approach the UFO's bright blue light, and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: on any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.
trophies.guide: On any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds — a melee drive-by. Crowded spots like Vice City streets or Ocean Beach make it far easier. The counter resets if the minute runs out, so keep moving and keep kicking.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: Yasmani in Vice City pays the most; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 per job.
trophies.guide: Launder a running total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and sell the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. You do not need $250,000 at once; the total accumulates, and bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 per job.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to spend it.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — a running total, any shops count. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest; there are 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 14 mod shops and more across Leonida, so it lands naturally if you kit out both characters.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 8 purchasable garages, about $160,000 total; the 4 story garages do not count.
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (about $160,000 total) through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which installs after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses). The 4 story garages do not count. Robberies — especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4 — are the quickest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: Moses only takes cars without trackers at first; from Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray takes tracked ones.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, installed after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked cars too. You need free garage space first (see Little Boxes), and each registration costs money — use cheap cars and bikes.
